overview: Opening a marketplace account is easy to get wrong, and a rejected application can cost weeks. We guide you through the registration for Amazon, eBay or Etsy, prepare the documents the marketplace asks for, and set up your store profile, shipping, returns and payout details. You enter your own identity and bank details yourself, and we never ask for your passwords. You finish with a complete account, ready for listings.

faq: Do you open the account for me?

No. Marketplaces require the owner to enter their own identity, tax and bank details, and sharing a login would break their rules. We guide you through each screen and check your entries before you submit.
What if my application is rejected?

We cannot promise approval, because the marketplace decides. If you are asked for more proof, we help you understand the request and prepare a clear response. We never fake documents or use someone else's identity.
Mostly the US, UK, Canada and the EU. Verification rules differ by country, and some regions have extra steps. Name your country in the order form and we confirm what we can help with.
Can you manage the account for me afterwards?
Yes, through Account Management and the other listing services. Add us as a user with limited permissions in your own account, so you can remove our access at any time.
